verdict.rationale: Obsidian's documented local-first design keeps notes as plain Markdown files on your own device and claims you have "total control over your data" (obsidian-docs-2, obsidian-docs-20, obsidian-docs-38). On Obsidian Sync, selective sync limits which files reach the server and version history covers restoring past versions (obsidian-docs-47, obsidian-docs-28). However, there is no documented retention setting or deletion workflow, so control over retention and deletion is implied by local storage rather than explicitly provided. Missing for 10: documented retention-period controls for Sync version history, documented deletion of remote Sync/Publish data or accounts, and independent corroboration of deletion behavior.
